# Contributing to AlgoVault 🤝

Thank you for your interest in contributing to AlgoVault!

AlgoVault is an open-source Chrome extension built to make coding-solution management easier across multiple platforms.

Whether you want to fix a bug, improve the UI, add platform support, improve the AI features, or simply suggest an idea — you're welcome here.

## 🚀 Ways You Can Contribute

You can contribute by:

* 💡 Suggesting new features
* 🐛 Fixing bugs
* 🎨 Improving UI/UX
* 🤖 Improving AI functionality
* 🌐 Adding support for coding platforms
* 📚 Improving documentation
* 🧪 Testing features
* ⚡ Improving performance
* 🔧 Refactoring code

## 🔎 Finding Something to Work On

Check the repository Issues.

Beginner-friendly issues are marked with:

* `good first issue`
* `help wanted`

If you're unsure about an issue, feel free to ask a question before starting.

## 🛠️ Development Workflow

### 1. Fork the repository

Create your own fork of AlgoVault.

### 2. Clone your fork

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/AlgoVault.git
cd AlgoVault
```

### 3. Create a branch

Use a descriptive branch name:

```text
feature/add-platform-support
fix/popup-layout
docs/update-readme
ai/improve-complexity-analysis
```

### 4. Make your changes

Keep your changes focused and avoid unrelated modifications.

### 5. Test the extension

Load the extension locally in Chrome using:

**chrome://extensions**

Enable **Developer mode**, then select **Load unpacked** and choose the AlgoVault directory.

Test the affected functionality before submitting your Pull Request.

### 6. Open a Pull Request

Describe:

* What you changed
* Why you changed it
* How you tested it
* Any relevant screenshots or examples

## 💡 Before Building a Large Feature

For significant changes, open an Issue or Discussion first.

This gives the community and maintainers an opportunity to discuss the idea before implementation begins.

## 🧑‍💻 Code Guidelines

Please try to keep contributions:

* Simple
* Readable
* Focused
* Consistent with the existing code
* Free of unnecessary dependencies

## ❤️ First Contribution

Never contributed to open source before?

That's completely fine.

Look for an issue labeled `good first issue` and start there.

Every contributor was a beginner once.

## 🌟 Thank You

Your contribution helps make AlgoVault better for developers everywhere.

**Build. Share. Contribute.**
